prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. TWO women standing side by side, each an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person.

#1: Emirati, in her mid 50s, sultry expression, warm radiant skin tone — an enormous, overwhelmingly muscular woman. Massive thick arms with heavy defined muscle, a broad powerful muscular back, a huge powerful chest, a heavy dense muscular torso and legs, only a soft hint of a waistline. Enormous round hips and colossal thick thighs with muscle visible through a soft layer, thick heavy calves. Not slim, not lean. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. Her face is a real living adult face, smoky bronze eyes, a soft nude lip, warm golden-tan skin, an elegant composed expression, cool ash-brown hair styled in high ponytail, real pores, real living eyes, 5 bars piercings set with sapphires in silver-toned metal, wearing four to six pieces, layered of silver a hair ornament. Fused with 4 different materials instead of ordinary skin below the collarbones, each material claiming its own region of her figure, covering every inch from neck to ankle without exception, the materials reading as one continuous second skin with no gaps. Her figure is divided into 4 horizontal bands by 3 hazy transition zones centred about 33% of the way down her figure from the top, about 55% of the way down her figure from the top and about 78% of the way down her figure from the top. Region 1 is everything above the first transition zone: it carries applied ELECTRIC VIOLET leaf, thin irregular metallic sheets laid onto the contour of her body with fine natural creases and overlapping seams, VIVID CYAN undertone glinting through the thinnest points. Region 2 is the band between transition zone 1 and transition zone 2: it carries koi scales (rounded smooth scales with fine visible growth rings, each scale glossy and slightly domed), BLAZING ELECTRIC BLUE scale formations, VIVID ORANGE scale-edge detail, every scale catching its own glint and casting its own small shadow. Region 3 is the band between transition zone 2 and transition zone 3: it carries polished obsidian stone fused directly to her own form, solid glossy black stone curving to follow her body's true shape, with molten gold seams running between fitted stone sections. Region 4 is everything below the last transition zone: it carries solid polished white marble fused directly into her own form, natural grey-gold veining flowing to follow every curve, BLAZING pale marble surface with VIVID golden vein striations. The boundaries between regions are hazy and feathered — there is no visible line at all. Each transition zone is about a hand's width wide, and across it the neighbouring materials dissolve into each other, elements from one thinning out as elements from the other appear, density fading rather than stopping abruptly, never a hard edge. Each transition zone follows a gently undulating wave, rising and falling softly, rather than a straight course. Even inside a transition zone the skin is never left bare: at every point one material, or a mixture of the two, fully covers it. The materials of every region continue in full strength over her whole figure, nowhere on her body left bare, no fabric no seam no garment anywhere. Pose: full side profile, one arm reaching forward, her extreme platform lace-up sandals, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone.

Background: a plain seamless deep-charcoal backdrop, nothing else in frame. Composition: each woman's own pose as described, inner arms not crossing her neighbours, generous spacing so every figure reads clearly. Lighting: a single hard key light raking across all of them from one side, sharp focus head to toe on each, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph not an illustration not CGI not a render. Pattern density maximum, zero bare skin from neck to ankle on any of them. Shot on a Hasselblad X2D, 3:4 aspect ratio, 8K.
